overview_description.description:
Laravel is a web application framework with expressive, elegant syntax. They believe development must be an enjoyable, creative experience to be truly fulfilling. Laravel attempts to take the pain out of development by easing common tasks used in web projects, such as authentication, routing, sessions, and caching.

Laravel aims to make the development process a pleasing one for the developer without sacrificing application functionality. Happy developers make the code. To this end, They've attempted to combine what They have seen in other web frameworks, including frameworks implemented in other languages, such as Ruby on Rails, ASP.NET MVC, and Sinatra.

about_short_description.short_description: Laravel is an open-source PHP web application framework that is commonly used for web application development.

product.name: Laravel Framework
product.description: An open-source PHP web application framework for building web applications and APIs with built-in routing, authentication, queues, database ORM, migrations, validation, storage, and testing tools.

product.name: Laravel Cloud
product.description: A managed cloud platform for deploying Laravel applications with autoscaling, usage-based pricing, and configurable databases, workers, cache, and storage.

product.name: Laravel Forge
product.description: A server management and deployment service for provisioning, configuring, and maintaining infrastructure used to run Laravel and PHP applications.

product.name: Laravel Nightwatch
product.description: An application observability service that traces errors, performance, requests, jobs, logs, commands, and cache activity in Laravel applications.

product.name: Laravel Vapor
product.description: A serverless deployment platform for Laravel applications that runs on AWS infrastructure and manages application deployment without requiring server administration.

product.name: Laravel Nova
product.description: An administration panel for Laravel applications that provides configurable resources, dashboards, tools, and interfaces for managing application data.
